question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3 AND page_id = 13
)
SELECT 
    CAST(p.product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
    p.page_name AS product_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS views,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS added_to_cart,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS left_in_cart,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS purchases,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) +
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS left_in_cart_plus_purchases
FROM shopping_cart_events e
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
WHERE p.product_id IS NOT NULL
  AND p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.page_name
ORDER BY p.product_id
